title: Feature flag rule set
description: The document the API serves and clients evaluate locally. Evaluation happens on the client so a flag can be read with no network, using the last cached document; the cost is that a change reaches users only on their next fetch.

version.description: Increments on every published change. A client must ignore a document older than the one it has cached, or a stale CDN edge could resurrect a killed flag.

key.description: Stable identifier. Clients hold a compiled-in default for keys they know; an unknown key is ignored rather than treated as off.

enabled.description: The base value, applied when no segment or rollout rule matches.

rollout.description: Percentage of users the flag is on for, when `enabled` is true. Bucketing is deterministic per user and per flag, so a user does not flip between sessions and is not in the same bucket for every flag.

segments.description: Evaluated in order; the first match wins and short-circuits the rollout.

value.description: What the flag evaluates to for users matching this segment.

maxAppVersion.description: Inclusive upper bound. Lets a flag be turned off for versions with a known bug without a store release.

userIds.description: Explicit allow-list, for testing a flag on named accounts before any rollout.
